blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Quezon provincial government is conducting a province-wide cancer patient registry, which requires an assessment survey to determine the number and status of cancer patients and identify their healthcare needs. The initiative, launched by Gov. Angelina “Doktora Helen” Tan, a physician, is being carried out through the Provincial Health Office (PHO). “The survey aims to determine the number and status of cancer patients in the province, as well as identify their needs to help develop more appropriate health programs and services,” the PHO said in a social media post on Tuesday.
